name: fotor
description: Connect to Fotor's production MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Fotor's production MCP service to discover supported image and video capabilities, upload media, generate and edit images, upscale images, remove backgrounds, and generate videos from supported references. Available models and options are provided by the connected service.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Fotor and introduce its main features.
Use Fotor to generate an image from my description.
Use Fotor to generate a video from my references.
